reserveReview.reviewer: GPT SOL-CORP-A wave6; Kimi T48 safety-v9 unknown-reduction w2 (dependency adjudication)
reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's live proof-of-reserves API enumerates every reserve position: a PYUSD T-bill sleeve plus 27 GPU-backed infrastructure loan deals whose shares sum to 60.89741894% PYUSD and 39.10258106% loans as of 2026-07-22. Slice names are aligned to the exact live usdai-proof-of-reserves adapter identities so the reviewed classification overlays the captured rows. Dependency adjudication 2026-07-30: sUSDai is a serial wrapper of USDai (asset() re-verified live at Arbitrum block 491177809 returning USDai 0x0A1a1a107E45b7CeD86833863F482Bc5f4eD82EF), so the PYUSD look-through slice is not an additional parallel dependency path — the PYUSD exposure is inherited through the reviewed serial edge to usdai-usd-ai, whose own verified reserve envelope is 100% PYUSD; the slice's direct coin link was removed accordingly and recorded as a reviewed non-link.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: USD.AI proof-of-reserves API position-level shares aggregated by bucket, fetched 2026-07-22
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every reserve bucket reported by the issuer API is identified; individual loan-level obligor detail inside the GPU loan bucket is published by the API (borrower addresses, hardware, APR) but is aggregated here into one reviewed exposure.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: sUSDai is a serial wrapper of USDai; this PYUSD slice is the look-through of the parent's backing. The PYUSD exposure is inherited through the reviewed serial wrapper edge to usdai-usd-ai (whose verified reserve envelope is 100% PYUSD) and is tracked on the parent asset, so the slice is not a separate parallel dependency link.
GPU infrastructure loans are private-credit positions, not tracked stablecoin dependencies.
